但既然赵安坤主动请缨，他也没必要争，说实话，他还真不在乎这么一个逃魂的贡献点。

赵安坤喜笑颜开，上前一把抓住老鬼的魂魄，指尖捏诀，打开阴阳通道，身影一晃，便带着刘老根走了进去。

事情已了，吴姜慢悠悠地朝着刘庄外飘去。

刚出了刘庄的村子，他又顿住了身形，眼神微微一动——既然都来了，不如去刘家的祖坟再看看，这里已经有了刘老根这么一个老鬼，会不会有比他还老的躲在那里？

想到就做，吴姜随即调转方向，朝着刘家祖坟所在的山丘飞去。

吴姜缓缓落地，放开神识感应了一下，又掏出自己的苍龙盘看了看，随即忍不住笑了。

身形一晃，飞到一座比刘老根的坟茔更靠上的坟前，也不知道是刘航的几辈祖宗。

吴姜伸手敲了敲墓碑，语气和蔼可亲：“老乡，在家吗？我来接你回地府了。”

等了片刻，坟茔里没有任何动静，仿佛里面空无一鬼。

吴姜呵呵笑了一声，手中凝出一道幽蓝色的幽冥鬼火，作势就要往坟头上扔去。

“大人别动手！小的马上出来，马上出来！”

坟茔里瞬间传出一道慌乱的声音，紧接着，一道鬼影，从坟里飘了出来。

吴姜停下手中的动作，暗骂了一句“贱骨头”，随后掏出勾魂索，轻轻一甩，就将那道老鬼绑了起来，又朝着下一座坟茔走去。

这次就顺利多了，吴姜刚一敲墓碑，里面的老鬼就乖乖地飘了出来，不敢有丝毫反抗。

没过多久，吴姜的勾魂索就像串糖葫芦似的，串了五个老鬼，一个个都垂头丧气，浑身发抖，不敢有丝毫异动。

吴姜提着勾魂索，缓缓走到最上方的一座坟茔前。

But since Zhao Ankun took the initiative to ask for help, there was no need for him to fight. To be honest, he really didn't care about such a contribution to the soul escape.

Zhao Ankun smiled happily, stepped forward and grabbed the old ghost's soul, squeezed the secret with his fingertips, and opened the yin and yang passage. With a flash of his figure, he took Liu Laogen and walked in.

The matter was over, Wu Jiang drifted slowly towards the outside of Liuzhuang.

As soon as he left Liuzhuang's village, he paused again and his eyes moved slightly - since we are all here, why not go to the Liu family's ancestral grave and have a look. There is already an old ghost like Liu Laogen here. Is there someone older than him hiding there?

As soon as he thought of it, Wu Jiang immediately changed direction and flew towards the hill where the Liu family's ancestral tomb was located.

Wu Jiang slowly landed on the ground, let go of his spiritual sense, took out his Canglong Plate and looked at it, and then couldn't help but laugh.

With a flash of body, he flew to a tomb that was higher than Liu Laogen's tomb. It was not known how many generations of Liu Hang's ancestors it was.

Wu Jiang reached out and knocked on the tombstone, and said in a friendly tone: "Fellow, are you at home? I'm here to take you back to the underworld."

After waiting for a while, there was no movement in the tomb, as if there was no ghost inside.

Wu Jiang chuckled, and formed a blue ghost fire in his hand, ready to throw it at the grave.

"Sir, don't do anything! Come out right away, little one! Come out right now!"

A panicked voice instantly came from the tomb, and then, a ghost figure floated out of the tomb.

Wu Jiang stopped what he was doing and cursed "cheap bones" secretly. Then he took out the hook, flicked it, tied up the old ghost, and walked towards the next tomb.

This time it was much smoother. As soon as Wu Jiang knocked on the tombstone, the old ghost inside floated out obediently, not daring to resist at all.

Not long after, Wu Jiang's seductive rope was like a candied haws on a skewer, skewering five old ghosts. They were all dejected, trembling all over, and did not dare to make the slightest move.

Wu Jiang held the soul-catching rope and slowly walked to the top tomb.
